name: Wakabayashi Ayumi
source:
Ayumi works in a bakery shop, "Marine", which is located near [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url]'s cake shop. She's [url=https://vndb.org/c27888]Sana[/url]'s best friend and they are classmates. She looks very young and tends to act in a childish manner. However, her illusion of innocence is both contradicted and enhanced by her frank talk about shocking subjects. Even though she says that she has a boyfriend, she seems to be rather interested in [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.jastusa.com/target-pheromone.html]JAST USA[/url]]
